name: 78666 · San Marcos, TX
findings: ZIP 78666 (San Marcos) has 214 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78666 (San Marcos) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78666 (San Marcos) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 26% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
